name: Yona Yona
source:
Nekura Yotarou is an employee of an old-fashioned love hotel "Hotel Yonaguni". One of his hobbies was peeking into the nightly affairs of his guests night after night.

One day while he was doing his usual peeking, he saw something he should not have seen. His destiny changes when he learns of a certain secret of the hotel...

A couple partaking in adultery, a guest wildly masturbating, his girlfriend participating in an orgy party behind his back... Now, what kind of nightly affairs will he be peeking at tonight?

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/11/yona/]official website[/url]]
translation:
根仓与太郎是老式情人旅馆“与那国酒店”的职员。他的爱好之一就是夜复一夜地窥探客人的夜间事务。

有一天，当他像往常一样偷看时，他看到了一些不该看到的东西。当他得知酒店的某个秘密时，他的命运发生了变化……

情侣偷情、客人狂自慰、女友背着他参加狂欢……今晚，他又会偷看什么样的夜色？

[翻译自[url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/11/yona/]官网[/url]]
